lead.event: Jhonlin increases its planned acquisition of a 30.25% stake in BYAN
lead.headline: Jhonlin raises planned BYAN stake purchase to 30.25%
lead.blurb: Bayan Resources amended its conditional share sale agreement with Jhonlin Baratama, increasing the planned transfer from 10 billion to 10.08 billion shares. On 7 October, the 10.08 billion shares traded in three negotiated-market transactions at Rp2,588 each, for about Rp26.09 trillion. The agreement remains subject to conditions precedent, and Jhonlin would hold the 30.25% stake after completion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: VKTR receives OJK approval for its Rp3 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: VKTR gets OJK approval for Rp3 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: VKTR will offer up to 15 billion new shares at Rp200 each in a 35:12 ratio, with about 25.5% maximum dilution for shareholders who do not exercise their rights. Proceeds will fund electric vehicle purchases through subsidiary SEI in 2026–2027, with the remainder for working capital. The recording date is 8 October.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: EDGE signs a Rp1.7 trillion credit facility with BCA
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: EDGE signs Rp1.7 trillion credit facility with BCA
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Indonet and subsidiary Ekagrata Data Gemilang signed the facility with Bank BCA on 2 October, with a floating rate and a nine-year term. The funds will support capital expenditure, fiber-optic expansion and data-center development, while increasing their liabilities.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BTPS plans a share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BTPS plans share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BTPN Syariah's proposal covers up to 10% of its placed capital and is subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 13 October. If approved, it will be funded from equity and completed within 12 months. Pro forma basic EPS would rise to Rp94.54 from Rp85.09.

deals_control.event: ENRG and Danantara commit US$450 million to HighPeak Energy
deals_control.headline: ENRG and Danantara commit US$450 million to HighPeak
deals_control.blurb: Energi Mega Persada is investing US$200 million alongside Danantara’s US$250 million for a total of 450,000 Series A 6% perpetual convertible preferred shares. The shares can convert into HighPeak common shares at US$9.50 each, and each investor may appoint one director. The transaction is expected to close in Q4 2026, subject to customary conditions.

deals_control.event: Era Media plans to enter INET with Rp2 trillion
deals_control.headline: Era Media plans Rp2 trillion entry into INET
deals_control.blurb: Adhie Massardi will remain INET’s controlling shareholder after the entry. Further transaction details are unavailable.

deals_control.event: POOL agrees to sell 30% of POLA to Cicil Technologies
deals_control.headline: POOL agrees to sell 30% of POLA to Cicil Technologies
deals_control.blurb: Pool Advista's conditional agreement with Cicil Technologies covers 1 billion POLA shares, with the value pending an independent appraisal and subject to OJK and IDX requirements. If completed, Pool Advista would retain control with a 46.34% stake, while Cicil Technologies would hold 30%.

earnings_guidance.event: PANI reports a 483.8% increase in H1 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: PANI reports 483.8% H1 net profit increase to Rp1.67 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Revenue rose 77.6% to Rp2.92 trillion as high-margin commercial land sales lifted gross margin to 75.7% from 58.7%. NH Korindo and Ciptadana maintained Buy ratings, with targets of Rp9,200 and Rp19,200 per share, and forecast 2026 net profit of Rp2.22 trillion and Rp2.24 trillion, respectively.

earnings_guidance.event: Indo Premier cuts its ICBP target price while maintaining a Buy rating
earnings_guidance.headline: ICBP target price cut to Rp10,800 as Indo Premier maintains Buy
earnings_guidance.blurb: ICBP sales grew around 11% year-on-year in July-August, while first-half EBIT margin was 21.8%, within 2026 guidance of 20%-22%. Phintraco also maintained a positive recommendation, forecasting 2026 sales growth of 8%-10% and net profit growth of 5%-8%, with a 12-month target range of Rp12,000-Rp12,500.

earnings_guidance.event: Analysts set a Rp70.5 consensus target price for GOTO
earnings_guidance.headline: Analysts set GOTO consensus target at Rp70.5 per share
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bloomberg-compiled ratings as of 7 October show 22 buys, six holds and one sell, with the 12-month target implying 127.4% upside from a prior close of around Rp31. Individual targets ranged from Sucor Sekuritas’ Rp32 to Citi’s Rp95.

earnings_guidance.event: SMAR reports a 184% year-on-year increase in H1 net profit
earnings_guidance.headline: SMAR reports 184% year-on-year rise in H1 net profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sinar Mas Agro's first-half 2026 net profit reached Rp2.34 trillion, while EPS rose to Rp816 from Rp287 and sales grew 1.07% to Rp43.73 trillion. BRI Danareksa Sekuritas analyst Abida Massi Armand said profit growth was driven by margins rather than volume.

market_structure_policy.event: FTSE Russell retains Indonesia's emerging-market classification
market_structure_policy.headline: FTSE Russell keeps Indonesia in Secondary Emerging, off Watch List
market_structure_policy.blurb: In its 6 October announcement, FTSE cited reforms including a 15% minimum free float and stronger market surveillance. It will update its treatment of Indonesian securities ahead of the December 2026 index review.
